prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup / scientific-educational. Create a single high-quality 16:9 wide landscape image showing the final demonstration of an algorithm for beyond-line-of-sight vehicle-road cooperative active collision avoidance, from INSIDE THE EGO CAR AT DRIVER EYE HEIGHT. This is the view through a real-looking windshield from the driver's seat, not a dashboard web app, not an exterior bird's-eye car, not a desktop monitor mockup. Include the lower steering wheel, plain instrument cluster and dashboard, windshield frame and A-pillars, matching an ordinary unbranded left-hand-drive vehicle cabin. Road and traffic occupy 70% of image. Realistic CARLA-style 3D simulator rendering in calm daylight, plausible road markings and geometry. Restrained technical demonstration, sparse thin flat labels and minimal debug overlay, white/gray and muted blue with amber for occluded unknown zones and red only for an observed hazard. No sci-fi HUD, no glowing trajectories, no laser beams, no rainbow heatmaps, no decorative multi-panel management dashboard. No visible driver's hands required, no vehicle logos. Use crisp readable short Simplified Chinese labels. Persistent small corner text exactly "车内视角 · 仿真概念图"; small footer exactly "画面与状态仅作示意". All overlaid annotations represent a simulator debugging display of the algorithm's outputs, NOT a real certified augmented-reality windshield. No performance improvement statistics, no claim of guaranteed avoidance.
Scenario 1: urban blind junction with roadside-supplemented hidden cross traffic. From inside the blue ego sedan approaching a four-way intersection, show the windshield view of a large opaque gray delivery van parked near the LEFT corner, partially blocking view of a red car approaching from the left on the cross street. In the MAIN driver-eye view the red target car must be FULLY OCCLUDED by the opaque van/building and therefore must NOT be shown as a visible physical car or solid camera detection rectangle through the occluder. Mark only a thin amber dashed outline around the visible occluding van / occlusion boundary and a small flat label "左侧遮挡区：未知". At upper right include ONE small synchronized roadside-camera inset, about 23% of image width, labeled "路侧视角": elevated camera on far side of the junction sees the physically SAME van and a red cross-traffic car behind it, red car clearly detected with a thin red box and tag "T-07". The inset must maintain consistent street layout and not pretend it is the ego camera. Next to inset or in a small uncluttered bottom status strip show exact labels "路侧补充：左侧来车", "信息来源：路侧", "车端决策：减速让行". On a small center instrument screen a very simple 2D local road sketch may indicate ego and reported cross vehicle, rather than see-through cars in the windshield. Keep the approaching lane unobstructed, the driver can see the stop line ahead, no collision. The image should make it instantly understandable: the car cannot see behind the obstruction, the roadside can, and the algorithm running on the car decides to decelerate.

Scenario 2: occluded pedestrian sudden emergence (Chinese driving term 鬼探头, no ghosts or supernatural imagery). Use the same plain left-hand-drive interior style and driver-eye viewpoint as scenario 1. In an ordinary residential urban street, ego car approaches a large opaque white van parked on the RIGHT curb. One ADULT pedestrian in ordinary clothing suddenly walks briskly from behind the van's FRONT toward the left across the ego lane. Pedestrian has JUST EMERGED, is physically visible near the front left edge of the van, in a credible position on the roadway, not floating or inside the van. Draw one thin red detection rectangle tightly around the visible pedestrian, tagged "P-03 行人". Keep vehicle hood, road, stop/crossing markings and surrounding architecture physically plausible. Place a thin amber outline at the occluding van / roadside emergence boundary with small label "遮挡边界". Include ONE small elevated roadside-camera inset upper right labeled "路侧先观测", showing the pedestrian on the far side of the same van at an earlier observation stage, so the roadside viewpoint explains advance information. It must be visually recognizable as a separate roadside observation, not camera x-ray vision. A spare flat bottom status strip says "行人突然横穿", "车端决策：AEB制动", "转向通道：复核中". No active steering arrow into sidewalk or another lane; this example illustrates braking and checking side space. Show no impact, no injury, no panic, no exaggerated red screen. The image should show the algorithm's product as in-car assistance: detect the emerging person, assess risk, command emergency braking on the vehicle.
